dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.text: Good afternoon! Welcome to Uralsk City Bank. How can I help you today?

dialogue.speaker: Tolegen
dialogue.text: Good afternoon. I'd like to exchange some US dollars into tenge, please.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.text: Of course. How many dollars would you like to exchange?

dialogue.speaker: Tolegen
dialogue.text: I have fifty dollars. What is the exchange rate today?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.text: Today's rate is 460 tenge to one dollar. So fifty dollars gives you 23,000 tenge.

dialogue.speaker: Tolegen
dialogue.text: And is there a commission fee for the exchange?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.text: Yes — our commission is one percent. So from 23,000 tenge, we take 230 tenge as commission.

dialogue.speaker: Tolegen
dialogue.text: So I receive 22,770 tenge in the end. That's fine. I'll go ahead with the exchange.

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.text: Perfect. I also need to see your passport to process the exchange.

dialogue.speaker: Tolegen
dialogue.text: Here it is. One more question — how much does it cost to send money to Pavlodar?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.text: A domestic transfer costs 150 tenge if the amount is under 50,000 tenge.

dialogue.speaker: Tolegen
dialogue.text: And if the amount is above 50,000 tenge?

dialogue.speaker: Teller
dialogue.text: Above 50,000, it's a flat fee of 300 tenge — very affordable for large transfers.

dialogue.speaker: Tolegen
dialogue.text: Great. I'll take the exchange and also send 10,000 tenge to my parents in Pavlodar, please.
